summary: Iteration 5 validates: (a) new /api/cantiere GET/PUT with 12 fields incl logo_base64; persists and reflected in sidebar Layout & Home hero; (b) new Tariffe fields costo_movimentazione_per_metro=25, costo_taccaggio_per_metro=20, costo_lavaggio_inizio_stagione=80, costo_lavaggio_fine_stagione=80, maggiorazione_scafo_sporco_per_metro=15; (c) tipo_sosta='fuori_sede' zeros costo_sosta/copertura/alaggio/varo and computes L*25 movimentazione + L*20 taccaggio; (d) antivegetativa_attiva=false zeros costo_antivegetativa and enables costo_scafo_sporco=L*15; (e) lavaggio_inizio_attivo/fine_attivo toggle costs 0 or 80; (f) POST /api/clienti tipo_sosta='invalid' returns 400; (g) /api/stats returns sosta_fuori_sede count; (h) PDF preventivo uses cantiere.nome + contatti in header (>3000 bytes). Backend 47/47 pass (16 iter-5 + 14 iter-4 + 17 lavori/regression). Frontend: Home page hero, CTAs, Impostazioni edit+save+persist, logo upload+preview+persist, dynamic sidebar brand name, ClienteForm 3-option tipo_sosta with Fuori sede toggling Movimentazione/Taccaggio fields + hiding costo-sosta, both lavaggio switches present, Tariffe page shows all 4 Sosta fields + Lavaggi stagionali group + Magg. scafo sporco inside Copertura group. All working.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 995 lines (well over 700 threshold). Cantiere model+endpoints, Lavori CRUD, PDF generation and calcoli should be split into routers/services/models modules to improve maintainability.
PDF header logic in preventivo_pdf builds contatti line via a large inline expression (lines 706-707). Extract to helper function for readability and reuse across future PDFs (fattura, report).

calcola_costi has 10 keyword args and mixes concerns (sosta/motore/lavaggi/antivegetativa). Consider a Pydantic input model to avoid drift between /api/calcola-costi signature, ClienteCreate, and Cliente.

Impostazioni.jsx save() sends payload including logo_base64 which may be several MB. There is no client-side compression; a 2MB PNG will round-trip fully on every save even when only nome changed. Consider PATCH semantics or split logo endpoint.
Layout.jsx and Home.jsx both call /api/cantiere on mount independently — consider a shared context or SWR cache to avoid double network calls when navigating from '/' -> '/dashboard'.

Tariffe.jsx simulation math still duplicates backend calcola-costi logic (line 103-113). Now with fuori_sede/scafo_sporco/lavaggi added, the drift risk grows. Would be cleaner to call /api/calcola-costi from the simulation card.

In server.py calcola_costi, when tipo_sosta='fuori_sede' movimentazione+taccaggio use base costs, but override_costi flow does NOT special-case them if user overrides — user overrides only take precedence when val != None (fine). However, base['costo_movimentazione']/'costo_taccaggio' is always set even for dentro/fuori (as 0) which correctly gets persisted; verified in tests.

The stale DEFAULTS dict in test_tariffe_motore.py had costo_olio_motore=55.0 (raw price) while the current server multiplies by litri_olio_motore. This caused test_calcola_costi_ricambi_dettaglio_9_items to fail on first run. Fixed by aligning DEFAULTS to 12 €/L semantics and recomputing all downstream totals.
Home.jsx has no data-testid on nome/slogan text elements — added via home-page container, but a dedicated home-nome / home-slogan testid would ease future assertions.

Impostazioni.jsx: no server-side validation for logo_base64 max size — a large paste through PUT (bypassing client 2MB check) is accepted by /api/cantiere. Consider adding a size guard in update_cantiere.
